text: Mabunz was an Arthurian hero. Some texts also call him Mabuz or Mâbûz. The name names the magician son of Morgan, the sorceress sister of King Arthur. It may be a form of the name of the divine boy Mabon, whose mother is normally called Modron. This leads some scholars to connect the Arthurian figure with Welsh mythology. Mabunz is also described as the son of the Lady of the Lake or of another Arthurian heroine, Clarine.
objective: Document Mabunz as an Arthurian hero possibly derived from the Welsh god Mabon.
